description: Eight chronic days and nothing in the acute window, so the last run was eight days ago. Without the gap branch this fell through to the thin-window refusal, which reported the arithmetic instead of the situation. recover was advertised by available_states() with no branch that could return it.

disclaimers: Workload ratio, a monitoring signal only. Not an injury probability, risk score or diagnosis.
Stop and seek a qualified clinician for pain that persists, altered gait, chest pain, or any medical concern. Nothing here is a diagnosis.
recommend.limitation: Return gradually over one to two weeks; do not resume at pre-break volume.
reasons: 8 days since the last run, at or above the 7-day gap bound
